data.description: A bone golem is immune to any spell or spell-like ability that allows spell resistance. In addition, certain spells and abilities function differently against the creature, as noted below. . Magical effects that heal living creatures slow a bone golem (as the slow spell) for 1d4 rounds (no save). . A magical attack that deals negative energy damage breaks any slow effect on the golem and heals 1 point of damage for every 3 points of damage the attack would otherwise deal. If the healing would cause the golem to exceed its full normal hit points, it gains any excess as temporary hit points. A bone golem gets no saving throw against attacks that deal negative energy damage. . A raise dead, resurrection, or true resurrection spell negates its DR and immunity to magic for 1 minute.
data.name: Immunity to Magic
